cards.text: Would you rather get HDs in every subject or have the perfect social life?
Would you rather write a 10,000-word essay or sit a 3-hour exam?
Would you rather have no group projects or no final exams?
Would you rather live on campus or commute every day?
Would you rather have unpaid internships or free coffee for your degree?
Would you rather reveal your grades or your screen time?
Would you rather have classes only in the morning or only at night?
Would you rather lose all your notes or lose one major assignment?
Would you rather have a perfect memory or unlimited motivation?
Would you rather graduate a year early or take a free extra year?
Would you rather always find parking or always get a study room?
Would you rather have one amazing lecturer or amazing classmates?
Would you rather ace an exam without studying or enjoy studying every subject?
Would you rather show everyone your search history or your assignment drafts?
Would you rather never do presentations or never do group projects?
Would you rather have unlimited printing or unlimited campus food?
Would you rather repeat your first year or skip straight to graduation?
Would you rather have perfect attendance or perfect grades?
Would you rather get free accommodation or free tuition?
Would you rather get free parking forever or free public transport forever?
Would you rather only communicate through emails or only through group chats?
Would you rather attend every class but never study, or never attend class but study perfectly?
Would you rather be famous on campus or completely anonymous?
Would you rather have your search history shown in a lecture or your camera roll?
Would you rather always find a study room or always find a parking spot?
Would you rather know exactly where you'll be in 10 years or exactly who you'll marry?
